data.animaCaption: Relaxing together at the steaming stone rim of a snowy hot spring with a floating wooden sake tray between them, Ayachi Nene on the left in a shoulder-slipped pink robe smiles shyly while Shiki Natsume on the right in a loosened navy yukata pours warm sake with a tipsy blush. Amber stone-lantern light glows warmly through the rising steam and falling snow.
data.promptProse: Framed closely across a floating wooden sake tray bobbing in the steaming water of a secluded snowy hot spring, Ayachi Nene and Shiki Natsume sit shoulder to shoulder on the warm stone rim. On the left, Nene wears her silver hair pinned loosely with damp pink ribbons as a steam-softened pale-pink bath yukata slips down one bare shoulder, smiling shyly with flushed cheeks; on the right, Natsume tilts a ceramic flask to pour warm sake in a dark navy yukata worn loose at her collarbone, her normally reserved face softened by steam and amber lantern glow beneath gently drifting snow.
data.story: 飘雪落进翻涌的白雾里，漂浮木托盘上温着一壶清酒。宁宁的淡粉浴袍滑落半边香肩，红着脸轻碰酒碟；身旁的夏目松开藏青浴衣领口替她斟满，语气被热气蒸得柔软了不少——「难得休假，今晚谁都不许提任务和作业。」
